hiding_and_theorem.finding: ePrint 2026/391 proves composable honest-verifier-zero-knowledge IOR/IOPP results with round-by-round knowledge soundness and a straight-line extractor. Pinned Plonky3 implements the full masking pipeline: ZK Reed-Solomon encoding, masked sumcheck, code switching, and a masked base case.
hiding_and_theorem.limits: The proved object is interactive HVZK/RBR composition. It is not by itself a malicious-verifier, Fiat-Shamir, concrete-QROM, or end-to-end parameter certification.

field_and_relation_constraints.finding: At Plonky3 commit 3152b14a89067c83775a8076cc262ffc48a1fd7c, HidingWhirPcs exposes a multilinear PCS surface and requires a two-adic base field, two-adic extension field, DFT, MMCS, challenger, and CryptoRng. It is not a drop-in univariate Pcs backend.
field_and_relation_constraints.entropy_gate: Every proving path must use cryptographically secure, unpredictable randomness; predictable mask randomness reveals the witness.

evm_state.finding: No public hiding-WHIR Solidity verifier matching HidingWhirPcs was located. Archived sol-whir is plain WHIR on an older proof format, and sol-spartan-whir verifies plain standalone-WHIR fixtures. An EVM implementation must port the complete masked transcript and proof shape rather than reuse the old codec.

qrom_obligations.finding: Do not inherit a QROM claim from the paper's post-quantum description. Establish a concrete reduction for the exact Poseidon or Keccak transcript, parameter set, Fiat-Shamir compilation, and all compositions used by PQTC.

completion_assessment.finding: The native hiding relation can be implemented without inventing a hiding protocol. EVM work is engineering, but remains gated on entropy, complete transcript conformance, and an independent composed soundness and binding calculation because the Plonky3 base-case report is diagnostic only.

field_and_relation_constraints.finding: Generic KoalaBear R1CS is supported through the Circom fork. Quartic, quintic, and octic extensions are exposed. There is no special repeated-block PQTC API; the exact R1CS relation must be built and audited rather than assuming batch structure survives compilation.
